The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). Under the FCRA, employers are generally permitted to conduct background checks, provided they obtain written authorization from the candidate and provide required disclosures if adverse action is taken based on the report. Therefore, the actions described are compliant with federal legal standards, assuming standard procedural requirements (such as consent) are met.
